explanation: With m.lib, the refined aztec36 candidate emits 616 bytes. Diagnostic alignment pairs all 174 instructions with similarity 1.0 and reports no source-shape hypotheses or register divergence. Exact verification remains DIFFER because 15 register-only FFP calls lower to .Fflt/.Fdiv/.Fmul/.Fadd/.Ffix references with no established binding to the observed resident stub IDs; the other 58 A4 references are layout matches in this standalone object. The harness rejected an explicit-regcall source before compilation because its pragma extension is not pinned.
